tokens.TITLE: Tic-tac-toe
tokens.SUBTITLE: A full nine-cell game with win detection, a draw state, and a reset — with or without an opponent.
tokens.ABOUT_BODY: Nine cells, eight winning lines, and a greedy opponent that wins or blocks when it can.
tokens.ABOUT_HOW: Assembled from two clicks in the guest demo: the theme, then the mode. The board logic is first-party, not generated at runtime.
